mentions.name: LegalRabbit docx plugin
mentions.description: A Cowork/Codex plugin for reading and manipulating docx files. It uses 2-5x fewer tokens than Anthropic's docx skill and is much faster, and can be used together with Claude For Legal.
mentions.problem: Reading and manipulating docx files with AI agents is token-heavy and slow with existing skills like Anthropic's docx skill.
mentions.audience: Lawyers who redline and draft legal documents, who almost always work with docx files.
